entities.summary: Capistrano Francisco Heim O.F.M. was an American-born Brazilian Roman Catholic bishop. Heim was born in Catskill, New York as William Charles Heim. He attended St. Patrick's Academy in Catskill. From 1954 to 1957, Heim was in the army and served in Southern California at the end of the Korean War. After military service, he studied biology at Siena College with the intention of becoming a veterinarian. However, he decided to pursue a religious vocation, entering the Order of Friars Minor seminary in Callicoon, New York, taking his first vows on 15 July 1960, and was ordained to the priesthood on 18 December 1965.
